messages:
reem: quick q 1: prefer modal or side-panel for in-console docs? modal forces focus trap, panel feels lighter. figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz-modal-vs-panel
oliver: side-panel by default. less disruptive for dashboards. but if content requires a step-by-step flow modal makes sense.
nina: +1 side-panel. make it click-to-open, not hover. ensure focus is moved into panel and we set aria-hidden on main content when open. provide escape to close.
reem: good. oliver noted focus trap for modal 1: if we choose panel we still need to manage focus and keyboard nav. any naming/CTA thoughts?
oliver: CTA should be contextual: e.g., 'View batching guide' when linking to a guide. fallback 'Open docs'. keeps screen-reader context clear.
nina: linking strategy: fragments for headings (#caching) and include ?src=panel for telemetry. ordering: /docs/console?src=panel#caching. add rel="noopener noreferrer" + target="_blank" for external links. aria-label = 'Open docs about caching (opens in new tab)'.
reem: telemetry event name suggestion: docs.link.open with props {source: 'panel', anchor: 'caching'}. avoid PII.
docs-ci: Note: docs heading-id generator job passed on main today -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions.
oliver: persistence: panel should close on route change but restore on refresh if it was open. keep behavior simple.
nina: accessibility checklist: visible focus ring, aria-expanded on toggle, role="complementary" for panel, aria-live="polite" for dynamic helper text.
reem: ok consensus: side-panel, click-to-open, move focus, contextual CTA fallback to 'Open docs', fragment anchors + ?src param, external links open in new tab with rel and aria-label, telemetry event docs.link.open. i'll update figma and ticket. thx :thumbsup:
summary: Decided on side-panel (click-to-open) for in-console docs with managed focus, contextual CTA copy with fallback, fragment anchors plus ?src=panel telemetry param, external links open in new tab with rel and aria-label, telemetry event docs.link.open, panel closes on route change but can restore on refresh, and a11y checklist items for implementation.
